study type: Secondary analysis (of a retrospective cohort study)
exposure: Maternal pre-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) category (normal weight, overweight, obese)
outcome: Primary composite outcome (stillbirth, neonatal macrosomia/large-for-gestational-age [LGA], neonatal hypoglycemia, erythrocytosis, hyperbilirubinemia)
cohort: The study evaluated 555 women with untreated gestational diabetes matched to 1100 non-diabetic women.
finding: Maternal obesity and untreated gestational diabetes independently affect adverse pregnancy outcomes, with their combination having a greater impact than each alone, and glycemic level contributing more significantly to adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Untreated GDM in overweight and obese women was associated with significantly higher rates of induction of labor and cesarean delivery, and shoulder dystocia was included as a secondary outcome.
